subject.title: [Feature] Prune stale orphaned sessions from Dashboard Sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a Dashboard-owned preview/prune workflow for unreachable Discord/Telegram conversation sessions, and what reachability and retention policy should it use?
rationale: Current code intentionally preserves durable external conversation pointers, while the request would make the Dashboard delete persisted conversation rows based on channel reachability and configurable age.

options.title: Specify preview-first pruning policy
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved design for eligibility, age default, transcript retention, permissions, and channel-owned liveness probes before implementation.

options.title: Limit cleanup to manual delete and CLI maintenance
options.body: Keep current selected-session deletion and sessions cleanup behavior, and decline automatic orphan detection for now.

options.title: Split by channel first
options.body: Handle the Discord-only overlap in the narrower related issue before deciding whether Telegram and Dashboard bulk pruning should share the same product surface.

recommendation.title: Specify preview-first pruning policy
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved design for eligibility, age default, transcript retention, permissions, and channel-owned liveness probes before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest mixed history across session maintenance and Discord/thread-binding helper boundaries that shape this decision.
